ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 21148, Dec. 3, 2008>
Article 1 (Enforcement date)
This Decree shall enter into force on December 6, 2008.
Article 2 (Amendments to other statutes and regulations)
(1) The Enforcement Decree of the Game Industry Promotion Act is partially amended as follows:
Article 20, subparagraph 3 shall be amended as follows:
3. Newspapers and Internet newspapers under Article 2, subparagraphs 1 and 2 of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers, or periodicals under Article 2, subparagraph 1 of the Act on Promotion of Periodicals, Including Magazines.
(2) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on the Business Affairs of Licensed Real Estate Agents and Reporting of Real Estate Transactions is partially amended as follows:
In Article 7 (2), "Article 2, subparagraph 2 (a) of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers" shall be replaced by "Article 2, subparagraph 1 (a) of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers".
(3) The Enforcement Decree of the National Health Promotion Act is partially amended as follows:
In the main sentence of Article 14 (1) 2, "magazines [bound periodicals regularly issued not more than once a week and registered under the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers" shall be replaced by "magazines [bound periodicals regularly issued not more than once a month and registered under the Act on Promotion of Periodicals, Including Magazines".
(4) The Enforcement Decree of the Tobacco Business Act is partially amended as follows:
In the main sentence of Article 9 (1) 2, "magazines [bound periodicals regularly issued not more than once a week and registered under the Act on Registration of Periodicals" shall be replaced by "magazines [bound periodicals regularly issued not more than once a month and registered under the Act on Promotion of Periodicals, Including Magazines".
(5) The Enforcement Decree of the Monopoly Regulation and Fair Trade Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 64-6 (1) 2, "Article 2, subparagraph 2 (a), (b), (d) and (e) of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers" shall be replaced by "Article 2, subparagraph 1 (a), (b), (d) and (e) of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers".
(6) The Enforcement Decree of the Value-Added Tax Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 32 (2), "periodicals under the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers" shall be replaced by "newspapers under the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers and periodicals under the Act on Promotion of Periodicals, Including Magazines".
In Article 58 (10), "publishers of periodicals under the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers" shall be replaced by "publishers of newspapers under the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers and publishers of periodicals under the Act on Promotion of Periodicals, Including Magazines", and "appraisal business entities or publishers of periodicals" shall be replaced by "appraisal business entities or publishers of newspapers and publishers of periodicals".
(7) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Management and Promotion of Real Estate Development Business is partially amended as follows:
In Article 16 (2), "Article 2, subparagraph 2 of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers" shall be replaced by "Article 2, subparagraph 1 of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers".
(8) The Enforcement Decree of the Income Tax Act is partially amended as follows:
In the former part of Article 12, subparagraph 14, "periodicals" shall be replaced by "periodicals under the Act on Promotion of Periodicals, Including Magazines".
(9) The Enforcement Decree of the Water Supply and Waterworks Installation Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 37 (2), "Article 2, subparagraph 2 (a) of that Act" shall each be replaced by "Article 2, subparagraph 1 (a) of that Act"; and in paragraph (4) of the same Article, "Article 2, subparagraph 2 (a) of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers" shall be replaced by "Article 2, subparagraph 1 (a) of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers".
(10) The Enforcement Decree of the Medical Service Act is partially amended as follows:
In Articles 23 (1) 8 and 24 (1) 1, "periodicals or Internet newspapers under Article 2 of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers" shall each be replaced by "newspapers and Internet newspapers under Article 2 of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers, or periodicals under the Act on Promotion of Periodicals, Including Magazines".
(11) The Enforcement Decree of the Act on Livelihood Stability Support and Commemorative Projects for Victims of the Japanese Military Comfort Women under Japanese Colonial Rule is partially amended as follows:
In Article 17 (1) 1, "periodicals registered under Article 12 of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers (including those published by the State or local governments among the periodicals under Article 2 of that Act)" shall be replaced by "newspapers registered under Article 12 of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers and periodicals under the Act on Promotion of Periodicals, Including Magazines (including those published by the State or local governments)".
(12) The Enforcement Decree of the Copyright Act is partially amended as follows:
In the proviso to the part other than the subparagraphs of Article 38, "periodicals registered under Article 12 (1) of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers" shall be replaced by "newspapers registered under Article 12 (1) of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers and periodicals registered or reported under Articles 15 and 16 of the Act on Promotion of Periodicals, Including Magazines".
(13) The Enforcement Decree of the Youth Protection Act is partially amended as follows:
In Article 4 (1), "publications under Article 2 of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers" shall be replaced by "newspapers under Article 2, subparagraph 1 of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers and periodicals under Article 2, subparagraph 1 of the Act on Promotion of Periodicals, Including Magazines".
(14) The Enforcement Decree of the Lifelong Education Act is partially amended as follows:
Article 66 (1) 1 shall be amended as follows:
1. A person who publishes daily newspapers, weekly newspapers or Internet newspapers registered under Article 12 (1) of the Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers, and monthly magazines registered under Article 15 (1) of the Act on Promotion of Periodicals, Including Magazines.
Article 3 (Relationship to other statutes and regulations)
Where the previous Act on the Guarantee of Freedom and Functions of Newspapers or provisions thereof are cited by other statutes as at the time this Decree enters into force, this Decree or corresponding provisions of this Decree shall be deemed cited in place of the previous provisions if such provisions exist in this Decree.
